text:
elaine: noticed a cluster of provisional-only token rows after the 14:02 rollout. looks like midstream retries produced provisional counts that never confirmed. short logs below.

omar: paste the logs + repro?

elaine: repro (curl):
```bash
curl -s -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-open-3b","stream":true,"input":"<long prompt>"}' \n  https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate?route=router-rolling
```
log snippet:
[14:02:05] req=req_9f session=s-501 route=router-rolling start
[14:02:11] s-501 toolcall:stream:start seq=10
[14:02:12] network retry -> replaying seq 10-12
[14:02:13] router:midstream-retry triggered fallback to smaller model
[14:02:13] router:close session s-501 reason=midstream_retry_truncate provisional_tokens=97 confirmed_tokens=0

ryan: seems the router fires a close without issuing a finalize. ledger expects an explicit confirm to flip provisional -> confirmed. if router just drops the session the rows never finalize.

omar: two short fixes: 1) router should call an internal /confirm with reason when it closes; 2) ledger should have an idle-auto-finalize TTL (eg 24h) that marks stale sessions as finalized_stale. both changes together will stop spikes and give deterministic UX.

elaine: agree. also add closed_reason enum values so console can filter: completed, midstream_retry_truncate, client_abort, error, auto_stale.

infra-bot: alert: provisional_to_confirmed_ratio on router-rolling = 0.38 in last 30m. ticket created AGENT-3401.

deploy-bot: deploy: router-rolling canary -> 15% (14:02) :rocket:

omar: implementation notes: confirm endpoint should be idempotent by (session_id,last_seq), accept {confirm:true|false, final_tokens, last_seq, reason}, and require internal auth. ledger behavior: ignore duplicates, set finalized_at when any confirm arrives, and store closed_reason. add metric session_finalization_lag_ms.

ryan: i'll take the ledger change and add the TTL job for stale finalization.

elaine: i'll open the router PR to call confirm on close and include tests for midstream retries. tagging @omar and @ryan for review.
